text: Hi!
Ghost fact.
I don't sleep.
Like... ever.
So I took a night job.
I look after AI agents. All night long.
This one answers questions for a software company.
Doing great.
Then, at three a.m., someone ships a tiny change...
and it starts getting things wrong.
Everyone's asleep.
Well... almost everyone.
So I dig in.
I read what went wrong, find the change that did it,
and even the prompt that wrote it.
It's costing eleven dollars a minute.
So I roll it back.
Then I re-run what failed, just to be sure.
All fixed.
In the morning, you get one message.
The real fix? That's your call.
Your agents work all night.
Now someone's watching them.
It takes five minutes to set up.
I'm Nightly. Go to sleep. I've got this.
